title: Veneers
what: Veneers are thin shells on the front of the teeth. They change the color and shape of the teeth.
why: When you want to change the color, shape, or small flaws of your front teeth, and whitening does not help.
duration: usually 2 to 3 visits over 1 to 3 weeks; one visit usually takes 1 to 2 hours
tell_doctor: If you grind your teeth at night
If your teeth or gums hurt
What result you want. Show photos

prepare.title: Treatment
prepare.text: Tooth decay and gum problems must be treated first, and a cleaning done.

prepare.title: Color
prepare.text: If you want to whiten your other teeth, do it before the veneers. Their color does not change later.

prepare.title: Wishes
prepare.text: Bring photos of a smile you like.

bring: Photos of the smile you want, if you have them
steps: The dentist examines your teeth and discusses shape and color
Often a trial of the future teeth is made first from temporary material
With numbing, a thin layer of enamel is removed from the teeth, though not always
An impression or scan is taken, and temporary veneers are put on
At the next visit, the finished veneers are bonded on
feel: With numbing, it does not hurt
At first, the teeth feel unusual, and your tongue notices them
There may be sensitivity to cold for a few days
after: Do not bite hard things: nuts, pits, ice, or pens
If you grind your teeth at night, the dentist will suggest a night guard
red_flags: A veneer chips or comes off: keep it and book a dental visit

faq.a: Usually many years, if you take care of them. It depends on the material. Ask your dentist.

faq.q: Do the teeth need to be filed down?
faq.a: Usually a little enamel is removed. Sometimes veneers are placed with almost no filing. Your dentist will say if that is possible for you.

reminders.text: Veneer visit tomorrow. Bring photos of a smile you like, if you have them.
